fields.label: Deployment
fields.description: One LINE channel per deployment (company × product). This is the isolation boundary: signature checks and outbound messages both use this channel's own credentials.

fields.label: Product
fields.description: DMS is the one already proven; ERP and Cowork use the same API surface.

fields.label: Channel ID
fields.description: The Messaging API channel's basic ID (@xxx), used for identification and troubleshooting.

fields.label: LIFF ID
fields.description: Fill in only if a LIFF app exists; otherwise leave empty.

fields.label: Credentials (stored only here, pushed to the tenant site at provisioning)
Channel Secret
fields.description: Used to verify webhooks. **One per tenant**: a tenant site only uses its own, so another tenant's signature will not pass.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.description: The URL to paste into the LINE console, derived from the deployment domain.
